profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Appetize
profile.summary:
Software engineer primarily working with backend technologies.

Specialties: Go, PHP, Python, MySQL

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description: SQL Server database development on Go Daddy's eCommerce team.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description: Creation and execution of automated test cases against Go Daddy's commerce systems.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•Developed a suite of 500 custom scripts to automate the testing of basic Bluetooth functionality (headset, FTP, A2DP).
•Performed manual compatibility, inter-operability and validation testing on dozens of Bluetooth headsets and handsets.

positions.title: Software Systems Engineer II
positions.description:
•Profiling using a variety of system benchmarks (e.g. lmbench, spec2k) on Linux kernel for set-top boxes.
•Developed a suite of UNIX shell scripts to automate the testing of basic functionality.
•Filed bug reports and coordinated with developers to confirm fixes with bi-weekly kernel releases.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description:
•Maintained PHP/MySQL based website, which tracked members' community service hours.
•Developed an anonymous online message board for members to express their comments and concerns.
•Created a self-updating face sheet that displays the photos of each member.
•Fixed numerous bugs to improve speed and efficiency of database queries.

company.name: Alpha Phi Omega, University of California, Irvine

positions.title: Student Programmer
positions.description:
•Assisted in the development and maintenance of Java based Data Warehouse applications.
•Implemented highly user-requested features, including adding expense querying across multiple years.
•Performed the migration of very large databases from Sybase to MySQL using SQL scripts.
•Created and modified front-end Java query servlets in response to user requests.
